import_policy.serialization: One atomic transaction protected by pg_advisory_xact_lock.
import_policy.brands: Exact semantic name+slug identity reuses; mismatch blocks the full set.
import_policy.locations: Exact reviewed slug+identity may reuse only on a true rerun; URL/address/near-coordinate conflicts block.
import_policy.hgy: namespace+HGY may belong to one location only; different ownership blocks.
import_policy.sources: Canonical governing-body source reuses only with matching location and authority.
import_policy.affiliations: Canonical relation reuses only when external identity matches.
import_policy.freshness: Reruns do not extend freshness; older observations never regress confirmed state.
